84:
WITH admin_names AS (
    SELECT "admfname1" AS first_name, "district" FROM "schools" WHERE "admfname1" IS NOT NULL AND "admfname1" <> ''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT "admfname2" AS first_name, "district" FROM "schools" WHERE "admfname2" IS NOT NULL AND "admfname2" <> ''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT "admfname3" AS first_name, "district" FROM "schools" WHERE "admfname3" IS NOT NULL AND "admfname3" <> ''
),

name_counts AS (
    SELECT
        "first_name",
        COUNT(*) AS cnt,
        (SELECT an2."district"
         FROM admin_names an2
         WHERE an2."first_name" = an."first_name"
         GROUP BY an2."district"
         ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC NULLS LAST
         LIMIT 1) AS top_district
    FROM admin_names an
    GROUP BY "first_name"
)
SELECT
    "first_name",
    "top_district" AS "district"
FROM name_counts
ORDER BY cnt DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 2;

WITH avg_diff AS (
    SELECT AVG(
               CAST(f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS NUMERIC) - CAST(f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS NUMERIC)
           ) AS avg_difference
    FROM frpm f
    JOIN schools s ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
    WHERE s.fundingtype = 'Locally funded'
)

SELECT
    s.school,
    s.doctype
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
CROSS JOIN avg_diff a
WHERE s.fundingtype = 'Locally funded'
  AND (CAST(f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS NUMERIC) - CAST(f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS NUMERIC)) > a.avg_difference
ORDER BY s.school ASC NULLS FIRST;
